name: EGRET
description: Data, results, trained models and figures accompanying the paper "EGRET: A Benchmark and Early-Warning Framework for Mangrove Canopy Decline" (submitted to Ecological Informatics). 01_data: processed monthly MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI (ORNL DAAC) and ERA5 driver tables (Open-Meteo) for 32 mangrove sites in 10 biogeographic regions, January 2014 to May 2026, with the extensions back to 2010 and 2000 used for a hindcast and a long-record study. 02_results: tuning, the comparison of 30 forecasters, ablations, the rolling-origin selection study, the long-record study, the hindcast of the 2015-16 Gulf of Carpentaria dieback, prediction dumps and the operational outlook. 03_checkpoints: trained models, including the reference forecaster. 04_figures: figures, canopy rasters and animations. 05_logs: training logs. Code: https://github.com/quin210/EGRET (Apache-2.0). README.md describes the layout and how to regenerate every table and figure of the paper.
